experiment.name: Geometry-Constrained Shared Pull-Off Observer
experiment.question: Are signed multi-PRN tracking innovations significantly better explained by a common PVT/clock pull-off state than by H0 normal dynamics after a BIC/effective-DoF penalty?

ablations.name: B0 exact
ablations.support: Full/B0 contrast-specific exact 1.0-s window, 0.5-s stride, and eligible PRN/event support before any comparison metric
ablations.definition: Frozen PRN-local GRU with sequence length 12 over the ordered prompt-normalized nine-tap means E4,E3,E2,E,P,L,L2,L3,L4; per-PRN score sqrt(mean(standardized signed prediction innovation^2)); exact binomial-tail max-q50/q70/q80 evidence with EWMA previous-state weight 0.75. Model/score bytes are exact, but all alarm thresholds are re-estimated from this experiment's cleanStatic calibration only.

ablations.name: robust pooled signed innovation norm
ablations.per_prn: For PRN i, h_i=sum over time t=0..49 then frozen q-channel index j of rho_1.345(z_i,t,j), divided by the number of observed scalar z values for that PRN.
ablations.event_score: median_i h_i across numerically sorted common-mask PRNs
ablations.availability_rule: Every common-mask PRN must be present at all 50 epochs; otherwise apply exact contrast common-availability removal.
ablations.role: ablation only; never final detection basis

ablations.name: no-geometry rank-1 common input
ablations.fit_matrix: On train-fit [30,140) only, X rows are m_t=coordinatewise median across valid PRNs of z_i,t; center each column by its arithmetic train-fit mean.
ablations.pca: S=X^T*X/(T-1); numpy.linalg.eigh(S); lambda1>=lambda2. If lambda1-lambda2<=1e-10*max(lambda1,1), A2 unavailable.
ablations.loading: Otherwise a is largest eigenvector, unit L2; sign makes largest-absolute component positive, lowest frozen channel index breaks magnitude ties.
ablations.design: Repeat a for every valid PRN at each epoch.
ablations.prior: Per contiguous window, lambda*x_0^2+lambda*sum_t(x_t-x_(t-1))^2; reset x prehistory to zero.
ablations.lambda: A2 scalar lambda uses config.lambda_selection MAP+EDF/GCV over exact common validation support.
ablations.score: Same observation-only MAP+exactly-once EDF BIC as Full; no attack fitting.
ablations.sample_count: Require T>=2 eligible train-fit rows; otherwise A2 unavailable.

ablations.name: geometry code/DLL
ablations.definition: Only preflight-proved code/DLL direct rows; any unproved row loading is zero and insufficiency makes A3 unavailable before protected access.
ablations.availability: Requires >=1 validated range row (code_error or carr_error); otherwise unavailable and mandatory Full validity is evaluated exactly.

ablations.name: geometry carrier/Doppler
ablations.definition: Only preflight-proved carrier range/range-rate direct rows; any unproved row loading is zero and insufficiency makes A4 unavailable before protected access.
ablations.availability: Requires >=1 validated rate row (code_freq or carrier_doppler); otherwise unavailable and mandatory Full validity is evaluated exactly.

ablations.name: independent unknown input per PRN
ablations.prior: lambda*sum over PRN contiguous segments [||eta_start||^2+sum ||eta_next-F2*eta||^2]; defines block-diagonal R.
ablations.reset: Any absence/gap starts a new PRN segment and eta_start prior.
ablations.q_shift: Use the same validated candidate formulas and exact one-time VAR residual assembly as Full, independently per PRN.
ablations.lambda: A5 block-state lambda uses config.lambda_selection on exact common validation windows.

ablations.name: signed EPL+code+carrier geometry shared input
ablations.definition: All ordered q channels in covariance; only preflight-proved direct rows load the shared eight-state geometry. Uses train-fitted common-mode nuisance and fixed-prior MAP+exactly-once EDF score.
ablations.availability: Requires A3 AND A4 plus >=1 validated code-family row and >=1 validated carrier-family row; otherwise INVALID_EXPERIMENT_NO_ATTACK_ACCESS before protected access.

ablations.name: fixed complex 9-tap
ablations.reason: No conditional_integrated_gru_predictor.pt checkpoint was located and existing code does not guarantee exact Full common support.

ablations.name: raw-IQ noise continuity
ablations.reason: Raw TEXBAT IQ is host-accessible but not VM-mounted; M1 is not defined on the exact Full tracking epoch/PRN support and cannot enter exact comparison without a preregistered support adapter.

ablations.name: geometry-conditioned relation model
ablations.adapter_rule: Apply the same frozen epoch+PRN mask to raw TrackingRows before common-clock removal, geometry, and complete-pair event construction. Existing historic score CSVs cannot be joined or copied.
ablations.fail_closed_common_support: If an event fails any requirement, mark it unavailable and remove that exact event from every compared method. Never silently replace GCMR.

relation_destruction.input_stage: Change only H/LOS identity after residual and all whitening inputs are frozen.
relation_destruction.rng: Use deterministic_randomness with control_id=LOS_SHUFFLE and segment object_id.
relation_destruction.operation: Draw permutations until a derangement with no fixed points, maximum 1000 draws; keep the first derangement fixed for the entire segment.
relation_destruction.unavailable: N<4 or no derangement in 1000 draws; no fallback
relation_destruction.draw: At each draw call rng.permutation on the numerically sorted PRN array; accept first permutation with no element equal to its original position.

relation_destruction.input_stage: Operate on per-PRN pre-whitening one-step VAR residual r, never raw q or z; then whiten with frozen mu_train/Sigma_train/Gamma and retain unchanged current LOS.
relation_destruction.segment: constant-valid-mask contiguous segment wholly inside one frozen phase, length L bins
relation_destruction.rng: For numeric PRNs sequentially, draw without replacement from remaining shifts whose circular distance to 0 and every selected shift is >=10.
relation_destruction.unavailable: If candidates are fewer than PRNs at any step; no fallback.
relation_destruction.draw: For each numeric PRN, construct remaining eligible shifts in ascending integer order, draw index rng.integers(0,len(candidates)), assign that shift, and remove it.

nonspoofing_controls.operation: Multiply every complex EPL I/Q q row by level, then rerun frozen VAR exactly once and every downstream transform.
Multiply Prompt I/Q q rows only by level, then rerun frozen VAR exactly once and every downstream transform.
Edit only C/N0 metadata; require bitwise-identical score inputs and outputs.

Per block, seed a permutation of numerically sorted valid PRNs and drop its first d; no added identity. <4 leaves score unavailable, excluded from alarm denominator and included in availability report.

nonspoofing_controls.source_blocks: Precompute eligible nonoverlapping 10-s residual blocks from train-fit [30,140), sorted by start.
nonspoofing_controls.source_selection: source block index=derived_seed modulo source_block_count; center each source residual q channel by its source-block arithmetic mean.
nonspoofing_controls.prn_mapping: Map sorted target PRNs to sorted source PRNs by cyclic offset=derived_seed modulo source_PRN_count; continuous source data required.
nonspoofing_controls.operation: Add alpha times mapped source r to every target PRN; unavailable if continuous source/mapping absent.

nonspoofing_controls.source: Same deterministic train-fit residual source-block selection, centering, and cyclic PRN mapping as EMPIRICAL_NOISE.
nonspoofing_controls.operation: Seed a permutation of numeric target PRNs; add mapped alpha source residual only to the first PRN.
For each target PRN use an independent derived seed, phi~Uniform[0,2*pi), and add a*sigma_j*sin(2*pi*0.2Hz*(t-t0)+phi) to row j; sigma_j is train-fit robust scale.
nonspoofing_controls.robust_scale: sigma_j=1.4826*median over train-fit residuals of abs(r_j-median(r_j)); zero sigma_j gives exact zero injected amplitude for that row
nonspoofing_controls.time: t and t0 are recording-start seconds; t0 is target 10-s block start

nonspoofing_controls.operation: b(t)=v_b*(t-t0), bdot=v_b, p=v=0; convert using validated B and pass through frozen VAR exactly once.

control_failure: After a valid protected run begins, non-clock control alarm behavior fails scientific G5 if eligible persistent-alarm ratio>0.10 or a run of 10 consecutive available alarms occurs. CLOCK_DRIFT specificity uses Epos/(Eclock+1e-12)<=0.25. Poor alarm behavior yields NO_GO in an otherwise valid run; only transform generation/semantics failure is pre-access INVALID.
metrics: worst provenance-valid DS3/DS4 pre-onset FPR; DS7/DS8 replay excluded

go_no_go.rule: Scientific gates G1-G6 apply only to VALID_SCIENCE. Any failed gate, including G5 control alarm behavior, yields NO_GO_PHYSICAL_HYPOTHESIS. Integrity/access/mandatory-availability failure is INVALID_EXPERIMENT_NO_ATTACK_ACCESS and never NO-GO.

mandatory_gates.criterion: At the empirical calibration q99 threshold, cleanStatic holdout FPR<=0.02 and worst provenance-valid DS3/DS4 pre-onset FPR<=0.05. DS7/DS8 pre-110 replay is excluded from G1 and all intervals/resampling.

On Full/A1/A2 exact contrast support with frozen scenario-phase-balanced weighting, Full low-FPR pAUC exceeds both A1 and A2 with paired aligned-block bootstrap one-sided 95% LCB (5th percentile) strictly >0.
For each destruction, Full low-FPR pAUC exceeds destroyed Full with paired one-sided 95% LCB>0, and the frozen median cellwise relative loss is >=25% on exact support.

At the 1% target threshold, DS3 and the DS7/DS8 family each have established-phase persistent-alarm ratio >=0.50 and pull-off first-persistent-alarm delay <=10 s; DS4 is excluded unless established coverage is authenticated.
Every non-clock non-spoofing control passes the frozen persistent-alarm failure rule, and clock-like drift is represented primarily by clock states.
On Full/A5 exact contrast support, scenario-phase-balanced Full low-FPR pAUC is not worse than A5 by >0.01 and Full has strictly smaller median effective DoF.

implementation_must_include_and_pass.criterion: Every feature, residual, state window, and alarm at time t uses no sample after t.
Fit, model selection, whitening, calibration, and thresholds use only their frozen cleanStatic roles.
No raw sample index occurs in more than one train/calibration/holdout role or crosses a role-contained score window.
No derived epoch occurs in more than one train/calibration/holdout role.
Timestamp derivation, half-open timeline intervals, onset, pull-off, and score availability anchors match the frozen contract.
Source/synthetic tests prove units and signs for every physical loading; ambiguity fails closed without attack-based selection.
Any PRN ordering permutation leaves scores and availability unchanged within numeric tolerance.
Valid variable PRN sets score consistently and fewer than four PRNs yields unavailable, never an imputed score.
Each relation-destruction control preserves every preregistered marginal/support condition and breaks only its stated relation.
Effective DoF equals trace(A) of the fixed-prior MAP smoother observation influence on exact observed coordinates and is included exactly once in the BIC penalty.
All compared methods use the exact same eligible event, epoch, and PRN mask; an unavailable event is removed from every method.
Two clean runs with seed 23 produce byte-identical scientific tables and JSON after canonical serialization.
Every required artifact passes SHA-256, size, path, ordering, recursion, and temporary-file exclusions.
A fresh clone at the pinned commit verifies inputs, reruns tests and the clean-only pipeline, and reproduces required outputs without untracked dependencies.
Source/synthetic-only preflight proves every requested direct row and deterministic impulse/ramp VAR-transferred gain before attack access.
Train-only deterministic Gamma estimator, PSD floor, and identical H0/H1 nuisance covariance pass.
Per-epoch rank=4 LOS checks and state-scaled stacked condition number<=1e4 pass.
With rcond=1e-10, 0<=trace(A)<=rank(G)<=n_obs and penalty is counted exactly once.
Epoch/window anchors, right-end availability, phase containment, missing-slot breaks, and causal trailing 3-of-5 pass.
Cell-balanced pooling and aligned paired block bootstrap, including DS7/DS8 family clustering, match the frozen equations.
A1, A2, and A5 equations, training sources, priors, resets, thresholds, and contrast-specific support pass.
Every mandatory holdout-only control and level is generated with verified semantics or validity fails before protected access.
Invalidity writes invalid_run.json and cannot emit or masquerade as a scientific final verdict.
Prove Sigma symmetric whitening, z-only median Gamma fit, arithmetic centering, independent c_t, exact C_t/blockdiag, and deterministic lower-Cholesky solves.
Prove exact B formulas/signs/test vectors, one-and-only-one VAR transfer, zero reset history, observed stacking, and C whitening.
Prove exact inner roles, common lambda support, per-window GCV, relative tie, minimum 100 windows, and sharing rules.
Prove cell/row weights, exact float64 ties, grouped ROC, alpha interpolation, trapezoid normalization, and paired support.
Prove nextafter endpoint blocks, full-window containment, post-resample weights, family clustering, and nearest-rank indices.
Prove SHA256-derived 128-bit big-endian PCG64 seeds, canonical orders, seed recording, and exact control stages/formulas.
Prove exact invalid set/schema, canonical manifest membership, target/evidence commits, and verification PASS distinct from science validity.

verification_contract.failure_effect: Scientific/semantic integrity failure => INVALID_EXPERIMENT_NO_ATTACK_ACCESS before attack access. Administrative packaging mismatch => VERIFICATION_ADMIN_WARNING and repaired verifier PASS before delivery.

protected_access_contract.preflight: Before any protected read, resolve the canonical path; classify scenario/phase/row range; verify authorization, source checksum, size, timeline, and allowlist; reject directories, globs, prior-result paths, and unclassified reads.
protected_access_contract.trace_rule: Append an immutable record before and after every protected access; a missing, mismatched, or retroactively created trace invalidates the experiment.
protected_access_contract.validity_gate: Canonical access preflight requires VALID_FOR_PROTECTED_ACCESS; any other state rejects and logs the read attempt.

contrast_support.rule: Support is contrast-specific. If an optional method/event is unavailable, remove that exact event only from its named contrast, not unrelated core metrics.

control_protocol.blocks: Non-overlapping 10-s blocks aligned at 350 s; no block crosses a role. Apply every frozen level to every eligible block.
control_protocol.history: Reset at every block and make first 0.20 s ineligible.
control_protocol.thresholds: Calibration-frozen; never refit for a control.
control_protocol.noise_source: Any injected empirical noise uses cleanStatic train-source blocks only.
control_protocol.generation_failure: Any mandatory control lacking verified semantics sets INVALID_EXPERIMENT_NO_ATTACK_ACCESS before protected access; it is not scientific NO-GO.
control_protocol.randomness: Use config.deterministic_randomness independently per object; never mutable global draw order.
control_protocol.validity_boundary: Generation and semantic verification failure is pre-access INVALID. Alarm-behavior failure after valid access is scientific G5 and yields NO_GO, not INVALID.
control_protocol.recording: physical_controls.json records NumPy version, all seed material/derived seeds, source choices, levels, stages, unavailable blocks, and reasons.

evaluation_schedule.epoch: epoch k=[0.02*k,0.02*(k+1)) from recording start; availability is right endpoint
evaluation_schedule.score_window: window j=[0.5*j,0.5*j+1.0) from recording start; availability is right endpoint
evaluation_schedule.eligibility: Window wholly inside one frozen role/phase; every residual prediction uses only prior epochs from that same role/segment after reset and 0.20 s warmup.
evaluation_schedule.pre_onset_fpr: Both the full window and its availability endpoint are strictly within the half-open pre-onset phase; endpoint equal to onset is excluded.
evaluation_schedule.phase_metrics: Full score window must be inside the half-open phase; straddling windows are unavailable.

persistence.schedule: Evaluate causally at each current emitted score on scheduled 0.5 s slots.
persistence.definition: Current endpoint is persistent iff at least 3 of the trailing 5 consecutive scheduled slots, including current, have score>threshold.
persistence.missing_rule: Any unavailable or missing slot breaks the run; it is neither a non-alarm nor bridgeable.
persistence.assignment: Persistent status belongs only to the current endpoint and is never assigned retroactively.
persistence.first_persistent_alarm: First current score availability endpoint satisfying the trailing 3-of-5 rule.
persistence.control_failure: Any eligible non-clock control has persistent-alarm ratio >0.10 or a run of 10 consecutive available alarm slots at any frozen threshold.

primary_pooled_static_contrast.weighting: Each included logical scenario-phase cell receives equal total weight. Within a DS7/DS8 family cell, split that one family weight equally across available DS7 and DS8 members; if only one is available it receives the family-cell weight.
primary_pooled_static_contrast.reporting: Always report every physical scenario-phase member cell separately in addition to pooled metrics.
primary_pooled_static_contrast.go_no_go_exclusion: No OOD or diagnostic cell enters GO/NO-GO.

g3_relative_loss.aggregate: median over eligible primary core scenario-phase cells on exact contrast support

bootstrap.boundary_rule: A score ending exactly at a 10-s boundary belongs to the preceding block whose data it uses.
bootstrap.final_block: Include only if duration>=5 s; otherwise discard.
bootstrap.score_eligibility: The complete 1-s window must lie in both the phase and assigned block.
bootstrap.resampling: Resample blocks with replacement within cell to original block count, preserving paired rows/masks. After resampling, recompute equal row weights within each cell and equal total cell weights.
bootstrap.ds7_ds8_family: Sample a family block index and include corresponding available DS7/DS8 members; never independent clusters. Pre-110 replay excluded.
bootstrap.percentile: Nearest-rank without interpolation: sort B=2000 values; index=ceil(q*B)-1 zero-based, clamped to [0,B-1].
bootstrap.boundary: No block crosses role, phase, or scenario.

validity.failure_rule: Write invalid_run.json, attack_access_count=0, do not open protected rows, and do not emit final_verdict.json.
validity.control_boundary: Pre-protected validation requires successful generation and semantic verification of mandatory control transforms, not their alarm behavior. Alarm behavior is scientific G5 after valid access; poor behavior yields scientific NO-GO in an otherwise valid run.

examples: plot PNG byte hash when plot data source is unchanged
admin_warning.effect: May be repaired in an evidence-only descendant commit without changing scientific tables or verdict; final delivery still requires repaired verifier PASS.

verifier_contract.exit_semantics: Exit 0 only on PASS; nonzero on FAIL.
fresh_clone_requirements: checkout target_commit exactly, independent of branch
clean-only deterministic reproduction when run status permits
no silent dependency on original-worktree untracked files

report_field_types.all_other_required_fields: nonempty string except hashes are 64 lowercase hex

field_semantics.commit: alias of target_commit for backward schema compatibility; must equal target_commit
field_semantics.target_commit: commit containing the scientific or validly fail-closed invalid artifacts being verified
field_semantics.evidence_commit: commit containing verifier reports; may equal target_commit or be an evidence-only descendant
field_semantics.overall_status: PASS when verification behavior succeeds, including correctly confirming a fail-closed invalid run
field_semantics.exit_code: 0 means verification PASS, not scientific GO; nonzero means verification FAIL

verifier_contract.invalid_run_verification: On invalid runs, checks use the exact invalid required set and overall_status PASS means the verifier correctly confirmed fail-closed invalidity.

inner_roles.containment: All are half-open; no raw sample, epoch, history, score window, covariance edge, or state-prior edge crosses an inner-role boundary.

lambda_selection.support: For each method, intersect eligible lambda-validation windows across all four lambda candidates before computing any objective.
lambda_selection.objective: Arithmetic mean GCV_w across the common eligible lambda-validation windows.
lambda_selection.tie_rule: For objectives g1,g2, tie iff abs(g1-g2)<=1e-12*max(abs(g1),abs(g2),1); choose larger lambda.
lambda_selection.nonfinite: Any nonfinite RSS, n, nu, GCV, or mean objective makes that lambda/method unavailable.

weighted_pauc.weights: Let C_pos and C_neg be included positive and negative cell counts. Each positive cell has total weight 1/C_pos and each row in it weight 1/(C_pos*n_cell); each negative cell analogously has total 1/C_neg and row weight 1/(C_neg*n_cell).
weighted_pauc.support: NaN/unavailable rows are removed from every method in that contrast by exact paired support.
weighted_pauc.ordering: Cast scores to float64, sort descending, and group scores for which float64 numeric equality (==) is true; update every row in an equal-score group simultaneously. NaN is unavailable and absent by paired support.
weighted_pauc.curve: Start (FPR,TPR)=(0,0); append grouped cumulative points; linearly interpolate TPR at FPR=0.05 if required.
weighted_pauc.integration: Trapezoid-integrate TPR over FPR in [0,0.05] and divide by 0.05.
weighted_pauc.unavailable: No positive or no negative total weight.
weighted_pauc.denominators: Total positive and negative weights are each exactly 1 before cumulative ROC construction.

deterministic_randomness.recording: Record NumPy version and every seed material plus derived integer seed in physical_controls.json or relation_destruction_metrics.json.
deterministic_randomness.component_encoding: Use exact machine-readable identifiers; block_id is base-10 integer b; integer levels are base-10; float levels use Python format(value,".17g"); missing/not-applicable components use literal NA; object_id is the frozen semantic object identifier.

scenario_relation_policy.single_class_rule: Use paired score-loss bootstrap within relation cells; never invoke binary pAUC on an isolated single-class cell.

invalid_run_contract.manifest_membership: Include every invalid required file except artifact_manifest_sha256.json, verifier_report.json, and fresh_clone_verifier_report.json.
invalid_run_contract.extra_artifacts: forbidden; access_ledger.jsonl is the complete access trace for invalid runs
